help: Probability weight for the AI to attempt a stick tie-up during a faceoff.

name: gChanceForShotAtPeriodEnd
label: AI Chance for Shot at Period End
help: Probability weight for the AI to attempt a shot on the faceoff as a period expires.

name: gSecondsRemainingToConsiderShot
label: Faceoff Seconds Remaining to Consider Shot
help: Period clock threshold in seconds below which AI considers a shot-on-faceoff strategy.

name: gFaceoffMaxIdleFrames
label: Faceoff Max Idle Frames
help: Maximum frames an AI player can remain idle before the faceoff system reassigns them.

name: gFaceoffMaxIdleFramesGetPuck
label: Faceoff Max Idle Frames (Get Puck)
help: Maximum idle frames allowed after a faceoff before an AI player moves to retrieve the puck.

name: gDefaultAmbientBlendFrames
label: Default Ambient Blend Frames
help: Number of frames used to blend into ambient (idle/offplay) animations by default.

name: gOffplayCircleChance
label: Offplay Circle Chance
help: Probability weight that a player will skate a circular path during offplay/stoppage.

name: gOffplayCircleMinRad
label: Offplay Circle Min Radius
help: Minimum radius of the circle a player can skate during an offplay stoppage.

name: gOffplayCircleMaxRad
label: Offplay Circle Max Radius
help: Maximum radius of the circle a player can skate during an offplay stoppage.

name: gOffplayCircleMinDistToBoards
label: Offplay Circle Min Distance to Boards
help: Minimum clearance from the boards required before a player begins an offplay circle.

name: gMovingSlowEnoughForStandingCeleb
label: Max Speed for Standing Celebration
help: Maximum player speed at which a standing goal-celebration animation can trigger.

name: gPostGoalCelebBlendFrames
label: Post-Goal Celebration Blend Frames
help: Number of frames used to blend into goal-celebration animations after a score.

name: gPursuePuckLooseInCreaseActive
label: Pursue Loose Puck in Crease
help: Enables AI skaters to pursue a loose puck even when it is inside the goalie crease.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PuckInCreaseTol_GR
label: Net Goalie Avoid Crease Tolerance (GR)
help: Crease puck-detection tolerance used in the goal-region variant of the avoidance check.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PuckInCreaseTolX
label: Net Goalie Avoid Crease Tolerance X
help: Lateral (X) tolerance for detecting the puck inside the crease for avoidance.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PuckInCreaseTolZ
label: Net Goalie Avoid Crease Tolerance Z
help: Depth (Z) tolerance for detecting the puck inside the crease for avoidance.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_GoallineTol
label: Net Goalie Avoid Goal-Line Tolerance
help: Tolerance distance from the goal line within which goalie avoidance is enforced.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_MaxPuckSpeed
label: Net Goalie Avoid Max Puck Speed
help: Puck speed above which the net-goalie avoidance system is suppressed.

name: gAvoidNet_GetPuck_NearNetDist
label: Avoid Net Get-Puck Near-Net Distance
help: Net proximity threshold applied when an AI skater is chasing a loose puck.

name: gGetPuck_AvoidNetBonusWidth
label: Get-Puck Avoid Net Bonus Width
help: Extra lateral clearance added to net avoidance when AI is retrieving the puck.

name: gMaxNetAvoidDelta
label: Max Net Avoid Delta
help: Maximum positional correction applied per frame by the net avoid system.

name: gMaxGoalieAvoidDelta
label: Max Goalie Avoid Delta
help: Maximum positional correction applied per frame by the goalie avoid system.

name: gAlwaysDoGoalieAvoid
label: Always Do Goalie Avoid
help: Forces goalie net avoidance to run every frame regardless of context.

name: gAvoidanceGoalieAvoidRadius
label: Goalie Avoid Radius
help: Base radius around the goalie that AI skaters attempt to avoid.

name: gAvoidanceGoalieAvoidRadius_BN
label: Goalie Avoid Radius Behind Net
help: Goalie avoidance radius used specifically when play is behind the net.

name: gAvoidanceGoalieAvoidNet
label: Goalie Avoid Net Zone
help: Net zone size used by the goalie avoidance system to keep skaters clear.

name: gReturnAfterRunningDivertAround
label: Return After Divert Around
help: Causes AI to resume original path after completing a net divert-around manoeuvre.

name: gDoNotDoNetCheckAfterRunningDivertAround
label: Skip Net Check After Divert
help: Suppresses the secondary net collision check after the divert-around path runs.

name: gAvoidance_DoNetGoalieAvoidInNeutralZone
label: Goalie Avoid in Neutral Zone
help: Enables net/goalie avoidance logic when the puck is in the neutral zone.

name: gDoAlternateNetGoalieAvoidFuncs
label: Use Alternate Goalie Avoid Functions
help: Switches to alternate code paths for net and goalie avoidance calculations.

name: gMinZPosForDivert
label: Min Z Position for Divert
help: Minimum depth (Z) position at which the divert-around net path is activated.

name: gBlueLineGetPuckBufferDist
label: Blueline Get-Puck Buffer Distance
help: Buffer distance from the blueline an AI skater maintains when chasing a loose puck.

name: gAvoidOffSide_BluelineSlack
label: Avoid Offside Blueline Slack
help: Slack distance from the blueline used when AI avoids skating offside.

name: gGetPuckGoalieAvoidDist
label: Get-Puck Goalie Avoid Distance
help: Distance AI skaters keep from their own goalie when pursuing a loose puck.

name: gGetPuck_NoDelayTicks
label: Get-Puck No-Delay Ticks
help: Number of ticks after a puck release during which AI pursues with no delay.

name: gPlayerWatchFightDistance
label: Player Watch Fight Distance
help: Distance within which nearby players stop and watch a fight in progress.

name: gPlayerWatchFightDistanceAlreadyWatching
label: Player Watch Fight Distance (Already Watching)
help: Extended distance at which a player already watching a fight will continue to do so.

name: gScrumChance
label: Scrum Chance
help: Probability that AI players engage in a scrum when competing for a loose puck.

name: gPostWhistleInCreaseX
label: Post-Whistle In-Crease X
help: Lateral boundary defining the crease area for AI positioning after a whistle.

name: gPostWhistleInCreaseZ
label: Post-Whistle In-Crease Z
help: Depth boundary defining the crease area for AI positioning after a whistle.

name: gDoNotCareIfGameClockIsRunningTwitchAnywayByStyle
label: Twitch Anyway By Style (Ignore Clock)
help: Bitmask by player style controlling which AI will twitch regardless of game clock state.

name: gBodyNoIntentUserPossessionTimeToHoldStyle
label: Body No-Intent Hold Time (Style)
help: Frames a user must hold possession before style-based body collision intent is ignored.

name: gBodyNoIntentUserPossessionTimeToHoldSkill
label: Body No-Intent Hold Time (Skill)
help: Frames a user must hold possession before skill-based body collision intent is ignored.

name: gStickNoIntentUserPossessionTimeToHoldStyle
label: Stick No-Intent Hold Time (Style)
help: Frames a user must hold possession before style-based stick collision intent is ignored.

name: gStickNoIntentUserPossessionTimeToHoldSkill
label: Stick No-Intent Hold Time (Skill)
help: Frames a user must hold possession before skill-based stick collision intent is ignored.

name: gOneKneeTakePuckChance
label: One-Knee Take-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for stealing the puck when the player is on one knee.

name: gBlockTakePuckChance
label: Block Take-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for the blocker to take the puck during a block collision.

name: gBackSkateTakePuckChance
label: Back-Skate Take-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for stealing the puck while skating backward.

name: gPokeTakePuckChance
label: Poke Take-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for a poke check successfully taking the puck.

name: gDiveTakePuckChance
label: Dive Take-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for stealing the puck during a dive animation.

name: gRandomChangeFrames
label: Stick Collision Random Change Frames
help: Frame interval at which the stick collision random seed is re-rolled.

name: gTicksStartValue
label: Stick Collision Ticks Start Value
help: Initial tick counter value used in stick collision timing logic.

name: gAlwaysLosePuckOnStickCollision
label: Always Lose Puck on Stick Collision
help: Forces the puck carrier to always lose possession on any stick collision.

name: gMinTimeWithPuckBeforeCollTest
label: Min Possession Time Before Collision Test
help: Minimum frames a player must hold the puck before a stick collision test triggers.

name: gNoStickOnStickNearNetFeet
label: No Stick-on-Stick Near Net Distance
help: Distance from the net within which stick-on-stick collisions are suppressed.

name: gNoStickOnStickExtraZFeet
label: No Stick-on-Stick Extra Z Distance
help: Extra Z-axis feet added to the exclusion zone preventing stick-on-stick collisions.

name: gReflexNoPuckAfterStickCollision
label: Reflex No-Puck Frames After Stick Collision
help: Frames the puck carrier is locked out from possession via reflex after a stick collision.

name: gAdditionalCarrierNoPuckAfterStickCollision
label: Carrier No-Puck Frames After Stick Collision
help: Extra frames the puck carrier cannot regain possession after a stick collision.

name: gAdditionalNoPuckAfterStickOnLegCollision
label: No-Puck Frames After Stick-on-Leg Collision
help: Extra lockout frames added when a stick collides with the carrier's leg.

name: gNoCollisionAfterOpponentStickOnCarrierLeg
label: No Collision Frames After Stick-on-Carrier-Leg
help: Cooldown frames blocking further collisions after an opponent's stick hits the carrier's leg.

name: gLayDownCollisionRadiusPadInches
label: Lay-Down Collision Radius Pad
help: Extra inches added to collision radius when the goalie is in a lay-down position.

name: gDampenPuckSpeedWhenStickCollidesWithGoalie
label: Dampen Puck Speed on Stick-Goalie Collision
help: Enables puck speed reduction when an opponent's stick collides with the goalie.

name: gDampenPuckSpeedDampenFactorMin
label: Puck Speed Dampen Factor Min
help: Minimum speed reduction multiplier applied to the puck on a stick collision.

name: gDampenPuckSpeedDampenFactorMax
label: Puck Speed Dampen Factor Max
help: Maximum speed reduction multiplier applied to the puck on a stick collision.

name: gDampenPuckSpeedReleasingShotFactorMin
label: Puck Speed Dampen Factor (Shot Release) Min
help: Minimum speed dampen multiplier applied to the puck when a shot is disrupted by collision.

name: gDampenPuckSpeedReleasingShotFactorMax
label: Puck Speed Dampen Factor (Shot Release) Max
help: Maximum speed dampen multiplier applied to the puck when a shot is disrupted by collision.

name: gBlocksBouncePuckChance
label: Block Bounce-Puck Chance
help: Probability weight for the puck bouncing free rather than being controlled after a block.

name: gStickCollisionWithLegOnShotDropsPuck
label: Stick-on-Leg During Shot Drops Puck
help: Forces puck drop when an opponent's stick hits the shooter's leg during a shot.

name: gBackskatePokeChance
label: Back-Skate Poke Chance
help: Probability weight for a poke check succeeding while skating backward.

name: gMaxOneKneeStickHeight
label: One-Knee Stick Max Height
help: Maximum stick-tip height for the one-knee stick collision check to apply.

name: gStickCollisionNoCollisionFrames
label: Stick Collision Immunity Frames
help: Cooldown frames that suppress further stick collisions after one occurs.

name: gStickCollisionGoalieNoCollisionFrames
label: Goalie Post-Stick-Collision Immunity Frames
help: Cooldown frames suppressing stick collision checks on the goalie after a hit.

name: gStickCollision_no_drop_puck_check
label: Stick Collision Skip Drop-Puck Check
help: Disables the drop-puck outcome check during stick collision resolution.

name: gGoalieBumpPuckOnStickCollisionEnable
label: Goalie Bump Puck on Stick Collision
help: Allows the goalie to deflect the puck when a stick collides with them.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PokeInCreaseActive
label: Goalie Net Poke-in-Crease Avoidance Active
help: Enables the rule preventing stick collisions inside the crease against the goalie.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PokeInCreaseR
label: Goalie Net Poke-in-Crease Avoidance Radius
help: Radius around the goalie inside which poke-in-crease collisions are suppressed.

name: gNetGoalieAvoid_PokeInCrease_Frames
label: Goalie Net Poke-in-Crease Avoidance Frames
help: Duration in frames that crease poke collision suppression stays active.

name: gPassInterceptionDistRatio_GapControl
label: Pass Interception Distance Ratio Gap Control
help: Pass interception distance ratio used specifically during gap-control defensive positioning.

name: gPassInterceptionDistRatio
label: Pass Interception Distance Ratio
help: Ratio of defender-to-pass distance used to determine if an interception is possible.

name: gPassInterceptionDistRatio_EmergZone
label: Pass Interception Distance Ratio Emergency Zone
help: Pass interception distance ratio applied inside the defensive emergency zone.

name: gPassInterceptionScaleDistFromPasser
label: Pass Interception Scale Distance From Passer
help: Scaling factor applied to interception radius based on distance from the passer.

name: gPassInterceptionMaxHeightForPassReceive
label: Pass Interception Max Height For Receive
help: Maximum puck height at which AI defenders attempt to intercept a received pass.

name: gBoardPinchMinPuckSpeed
label: Board Pinch Min Puck Speed
help: Minimum puck speed before AI considers executing a board pinch interception.

name: gBoardPinchMinPuckSpeedWithHeight
label: Board Pinch Min Puck Speed With Height
help: Minimum puck speed threshold when puck height is also factored into board pinch check.

name: gBoardPinchExitMinPuckSpeed
label: Board Pinch Exit Min Puck Speed
help: Minimum puck speed required to exit board pinch and return to normal interception logic.

name: gBoardPinchMinHeight
label: Board Pinch Min Puck Height
help: Minimum puck height required for AI to initiate a board pinch interception.

name: gBoardPinchMaxHeight
label: Board Pinch Max Puck Height
help: Maximum puck height allowed for AI to execute a board pinch interception attempt.

name: gBoardPinchPlayerDistFromBoards
label: Board Pinch Player Distance From Boards
help: Maximum distance from the boards a player can be to qualify for a board pinch.

name: gBoardPinchPuckDistFromBoards
label: Board Pinch Puck Distance From Boards
help: Maximum distance from the boards the puck can be to trigger a board pinch attempt.

name: gBoardPinchNumLookAheadFrames
label: Board Pinch Look Ahead Frames
help: Number of frames ahead AI looks when predicting board pinch interception opportunities.

name: gEnableTwitchOneTimers
label: Enable Twitch One-Timers
help: Enables AI twitch/reaction one-timer shot attempts during defensive interceptions.

name: gTwitchOneTimersMaxFrames
label: CPU One-Timer Max Decision Frames
help: Maximum frames the AI has to decide whether to attempt a one-timer.

name: gTwitchOneTimersMinFrames
label: CPU One-Timer Min Decision Frames
help: Minimum frames before the AI can decide to trigger a one-timer.

name: gMinChanceToDoCpuTwitchOnetimerOnRush
label: CPU Twitch One-Timer Min Chance On Rush
help: Minimum probability that an AI player attempts a twitch one-timer during a rush.

name: gMinChanceToDoCpuTwitchOnetimer
label: CPU Twitch One-Timer Min Chance
help: Minimum probability that an AI player attempts a twitch one-timer.

name: gOneTimerToleranceRadius
label: One-Timer Tolerance Radius
help: Radius within which a CPU player will attempt a one-timer shot.

name: gCpuOneTimerFreq
label: CPU One-Timer Frequency
help: Controls how often CPU players attempt one-timer shots.

name: gOneTimerChanceFactorOneTimerSpecialist
label: One-Timer Specialist Chance Factor
help: Multiplies CPU one-timer attempt probability for one-timer specialist players.

name: gAIJumpOverForecastTime
label: AI Jump-Over Forecast Time
help: How far ahead (seconds) the AI forecasts to decide whether to jump over a defender.

name: gAIJumpOverBlockerForecastTime
label: AI Jump-Over Blocker Forecast Time
help: How far ahead (seconds) the AI predicts a blocker's position for jump-over decisions.

name: gAIJumpOverMaxDist
label: AI Jump-Over Max Distance
help: Maximum distance from a blocker at which an AI jump-over attempt can be initiated.

name: gAIJumpOverBlockerMaxPelvisHeight
label: AI Jump-Over Blocker Max Pelvis Height
help: Maximum blocker pelvis height that still allows an AI jump-over to trigger.

name: gAIJumpOverDiveBlock
label: AI Jump-Over Dive Block Enable
help: Enables AI players to attempt dive-block moves to counter jump-overs.

name: gAIJumpOverNotOnGetup
label: AI Jump-Over Block on Getup
help: Prevents AI jump-overs while the player is getting up from the ice.

name: gAIJumpOverNotFromBackPies
label: AI Jump-Over Block from Behind
help: Prevents AI jump-overs when the approach is from directly behind the blocker.

name: gAIJumpOverMinVelocity
label: AI Jump-Over Min Velocity
help: Minimum skater speed required for the AI to attempt a jump-over move.

name: gAIJumpOverMaxAngleDiff
label: AI Jump-Over Max Angle Difference
help: Maximum angular deviation from the blocker's facing that permits a jump-over.

name: gAIJumpOverAttribMinChance
label: AI Jump-Over Attribute Min Chance
help: Minimum probability that low player attributes allow an AI jump-over attempt.

name: gAIJumpOverAttribMaxChance
label: AI Jump-Over Attribute Max Chance
help: Maximum probability that high player attributes trigger an AI jump-over attempt.

name: gAIJumpOverMinProbDangler
label: AI Jump-Over Min Prob (Dangler)
help: Minimum probability floor for AI jump-overs when the player has the dangler trait.

name: gAIJumpOverMaxProbNotDangler
label: AI Jump-Over Max Prob (Non-Dangler)
help: Upper probability cap for AI jump-overs by players without the dangler trait.

name: gAIJumpOverMinNetDist
label: AI Jump-Over Min Net Distance
help: Minimum distance from the net required to allow an AI jump-over attempt.

name: gAssumedJumpOverDist
label: Assumed Jump-Over Distance
help: Default distance assumed by the AI when planning a jump-over trajectory.

name: gAcrossBodyDistForMinCosAngle
label: Across-Body Distance for Min Cos Angle
help: Lateral distance at which the across-body angle cosine reaches its minimum value.

name: gCosAngleAcrossBodyClosest
label: Cos Angle Across Body (Closest)
help: Cosine threshold used for closest-point across-body classification.

name: gAcrossBodyDistForMaxCosAngle
label: Across-Body Distance for Max Cos Angle
help: Lateral distance at which the across-body angle cosine reaches its maximum value.

name: gCosAngleAcrossBodyAlways
label: Cos Angle Across Body (Always)
help: Cosine threshold that always classifies a puck position as across the body.

name: gDisableSweepTwitching
label: Disable Sweep Twitching
help: Disables jitter-correction twitching behavior during dive sweep animations.

name: gEnableSweepTwitching_IZOnly
label: Enable Sweep Twitching (Defensive Zone Only)
help: Enables sweep twitching correction only when the player is in their own zone.

name: gMinSweepAngleDegrees
label: Min Sweep Angle
help: Minimum angular deviation (degrees) that triggers a sweep twitching correction.

name: gMinEffortToCancelSweep
label: Min Effort to Cancel Sweep
help: Minimum input effort threshold required for a player to cancel an active sweep.

name: gMinSpeedToCancelSweep
label: Min Speed to Cancel Sweep
help: Minimum skater speed required to cancel an in-progress sweep animation.

name: gMinPCEffortToCancelSweep
label: Min Player-Controlled Effort to Cancel Sweep
help: Minimum effort required from a human-controlled player to cancel a sweep.

name: gAutoSweepStartDegrees
label: Auto Sweep Start Angle
help: Starting angle (degrees) of the automated sweep arc during a dive sweep.

name: gAutoSweepEndDegrees
label: Auto Sweep End Angle
help: Ending angle (degrees) of the automated sweep arc during a dive sweep.

name: gAutoSweepDelay
label: Auto Sweep Delay
help: Delay before an automatic sweep animation begins after the trigger condition.

name: gAutoSweepMaxDist
label: Auto Sweep Max Distance
help: Maximum distance from the puck at which an auto sweep can be triggered.

name: gDiveSweepBodyRadius
label: Dive Sweep Body Radius
help: Collision body radius applied to the player during a dive sweep animation.

name: gDiveSweepReactionFrequency
label: Dive Sweep Reaction Frequency
help: How frequently the AI updates its dive sweep direction toward the puck.

name: gDiveNoStickOnStickCollTime
label: Dive Stick Collision Suppress Time
help: Duration after a dive at which stick-on-stick collisions are disabled.

name: gDivePokePuckContactScale
label: Dive Poke Puck Contact Scale
help: Multiplier on the contact radius used when the puck is poked during a dive.

name: gDesperationShotCollisions
label: Desperation Shot Collisions Enable
help: Enables physical collision detection during desperation shot animations.

name: gDesperationShotReactionFrequency
label: Desperation Shot Reaction Frequency
help: How frequently the AI recalculates its reaction to an incoming desperation shot.

name: gDesperationShotNoStickOnStickCollTime
label: Desperation Shot Stick Collision Suppress Time
help: Duration after desperation shot during which stick-on-stick collisions are suppressed.

name: gShootingDrillFacingOffset
label: Shooting Drill Facing Offset
help: Angular offset applied to the AI facing direction during a shooting drill approach.

name: gCloseToNetDist
label: Close-to-Net Distance
help: Distance from the net below which a player is considered to be in close-to-net position.

name: gUseFaceDirSpeed
label: Use Face Direction Speed
help: Enables use of a contextual facing speed value for AI player directional turns.

name: gFrontNetZOffset
label: Front Net Z Offset
help: Z offset in front of the net used as a positioning target for shooting drill AI.

name: gLookUpIceDistFromBlue
label: Look Up Ice Distance from Blue Line
help: Distance from the blue line at which a player looks up-ice during a regroup.

name: gAngleToPuckToFaceSquareUpIce
label: Angle to Puck to Face Square (Up Ice)
help: Angle to the puck at which the AI will square its facing toward the up-ice direction.

name: gAngleToPuckToTurn
label: Angle to Puck to Turn
help: Angle difference between facing and puck that triggers the player to begin turning.

name: gRegroupFaceUpIce
label: Regroup Face Up Ice
help: Causes AI players to face up ice when regrouping instead of tracking the puck carrier.

name: gRegroupFaceUpIceIfBackForPass
label: Regroup Face Up Ice If Back for Pass
help: Forces a player to face up ice when regrouping back to receive a breakout pass.

name: gRegroupMaxEffortToFaceUpIce
label: Regroup Max Effort to Face Up Ice
help: Maximum effort/turn-rate multiplier applied when a player faces up ice on a regroup.

name: gRegroupMaxEffortToFaceUpIceAlreadyRequested
label: Regroup Max Effort to Face Up Ice (Already Requested)
help: Turn-rate multiplier for facing up ice when the regroup request was already triggered.

name: gRegroupMaxDistAheadOfPuckToFaceUpIce
label: Regroup Max Dist Ahead of Puck to Face Up Ice
help: Maximum distance ahead of the puck at which a player will still face up ice on regroup.

name: gRegroupMaxDistAheadOfPuckToFaceUpIceAlreadyRequested
label: Regroup Max Dist Ahead of Puck (Already Requested)
help: Up-ice facing distance threshold for regroup when a face-up request was already issued.

name: gTargetToTurnTowardsFutureCarrierFrames
label: Frames to Turn Toward Future Carrier
help: Look-ahead frames used to predict the puck carrier position for AI turning decisions.

name: gTargetToTurnTowardsFuturePuckFrames
label: Frames to Turn Toward Future Puck
help: Look-ahead frames used to predict loose puck position for AI turning decisions.

name: gAllowForceBackskate
label: Allow Force Backskate
help: Enables the engine to force defenders into a backskate during shooting drills.

name: gAlwaysForceBackskate
label: Always Force Backskate
help: Forces defenders to always backskate during shooting drills, ignoring other conditions.

name: gForceDefBackskateAlwaysFacingUpIce
label: Force Defender Backskate Always Face Up Ice
help: Forces a backskating defender to always keep facing up ice during drill movement.

name: gFeetToDestToUseVeldirForFacingCpu
label: Feet to Dest to Use Velocity Dir for Facing (CPU)
help: Distance to destination below which CPU uses velocity direction instead of target for facing.

name: gMinVelocityToUseDestForVisConAngle
label: Min Velocity to Use Dest for Vision Cone Angle
help: Minimum speed before the destination point is used to compute AI vision cone angle.

name: gIdealAngleToTargetForFwdSkateOffset
label: Ideal Angle to Target for Fwd Skate Offset
help: Ideal angle to the target at which AI transitions to forward skating during approach.

name: gRangeFromIdealAngleToPreferFwdSkate
label: Range from Ideal Angle to Prefer Fwd Skate
help: Angular tolerance around the ideal target angle for preferring forward skating.

name: gIdealAngleToNetForFwdSkateOffset
label: Ideal Angle to Net for Fwd Skate Offset
help: Ideal angle to the net at which the AI prefers forward skating during a drill approach.

name: gRangeFromIdealAngleToNetToPreferFwdSkate
label: Range from Ideal Net Angle to Prefer Fwd Skate
help: Angular range around the ideal net angle within which forward skating is preferred.

name: gFutureVelDirBias
label: Future Velocity Direction Bias
help: Blend bias between current and predicted future velocity direction for AI facing.

name: gUseDestinationForFutureVelDir
label: Use Destination for Future Velocity Dir
help: Uses the AI destination point to compute future velocity direction instead of current path.

name: gForceUseDestinationForFutureVelDir
label: Force Use Destination for Future Velocity Dir
help: Forces AI to derive future velocity direction from destination rather than current movement.

name: gAngleAtSkaterToAngleRatioGoodSide
label: One-Timer Angle Ratio (Good Side)
help: Angle-to-ratio mapping for skater facing a one-timer from the strong/good shooting side.

name: gAngleAtSkaterToAngleRatioBadSide
label: One-Timer Angle Ratio (Bad Side)
help: Angle-to-ratio mapping for skater facing a one-timer from the off/bad shooting side.

name: gFacingForOneTimerFutureFrames
label: One-Timer Facing Lookahead Frames
help: Number of frames ahead the AI predicts skater facing direction for one-timer alignment.

name: gFacingForDefenseFocusFutureFrames
label: Defense Focus Facing Future Frames
help: Future frame lookahead for defense focus facing direction calculation.

name: gFacingForDefenseFocusMaxFacingDegreesAwayFromPuck
label: Defense Focus Max Facing Degrees from Puck
help: Maximum degrees a defender may face away from the puck in defense focus.

name: gFacingXDistToDestToUpIceToPuck
label: Facing X Dist to Dest for Up-Ice-to-Puck
help: X distance threshold to destination that triggers up-ice-to-puck facing.

name: gFacingXUpIceToPuckRatio
label: Facing X Up-Ice to Puck Ratio
help: Blend ratio between up-ice direction and puck direction for X-axis facing.

name: gFacingMinDistFromOffGoallineFeet
label: Facing Min Distance from Offensive Goalline
help: Minimum distance from the offensive goalline to apply defense focus facing.

name: gFacingDistOverBlueToCurXRatio
label: Facing Distance Over Blue to Current X Ratio
help: Ratio blending distance over blue line to current X position for facing.

name: gFacingDoRatioToPuckAlways
label: Facing Always Use Ratio to Puck
help: Always applies the ratio-to-puck facing calculation in defense focus.

name: gDefenseFocusFeetAlongAngle
label: Defense Focus Feet Along Angle
help: Feet offset along the target angle in defense focus vision control.

name: gAngleFromUpIceToPivot
label: Angle from Up-Ice to Pivot
help: Angle between the up-ice direction and the defensive pivot point.

name: gAngleFromUpIceToPivotWithResist
label: Angle from Up-Ice to Pivot (With Resist)
help: Angle to pivot used when the defensive player is resisting the pivot.

name: gDestAngleFromUpIceToPivot
label: Destination Angle from Up-Ice to Pivot
help: Angle from up-ice to pivot used for the destination in defensive backskate.

name: gDestAngleFromUpIceToPivotWithResist
label: Destination Angle to Pivot (With Resist)
help: Destination pivot angle used when the defender is resisting the pivot turn.

name: gMinSkaterMPHToPivot
label: Min Speed To Pivot
help: Minimum skater speed required for the AI to allow a pivot transition during backskate.

help: Forces maximum effort to the far post specifically during rush situations.

name: gInzoneNearPostDeflectMaxFeetFromNetForVisionControl
label: Near Post Deflect Max Feet from Net (Vision Control)
help: Maximum feet from the net where vision control mode is used for near-post deflection.

name: gInzoneHighSlotPosZMax
label: High Slot Z Position Max
help: Maximum Z depth for the high slot in-zone offensive position.

name: gInzoneHighSlotFutureFrames
label: High Slot Future Prediction Frames
help: Frames ahead the high-slot player predicts puck position for in-zone deflection plays.

name: gInzoneHighSlotFuturePuckPosToXShiftFeet
label: High Slot Future Puck Position to X Shift
help: Maps predicted future puck position to a lateral X-shift for the high slot player.

name: gFarCircleDeflectZDistToXFactorToTargetPos
label: Far Circle Deflect Z Distance to X Factor
help: Maps Z distance to an X factor when computing the deflection target position at the far circle.

name: gFarCircleDeflectMaxXDistFromTarget
label: Far Circle Deflect Max X Distance from Target
help: Maximum lateral distance from the target position for a far-circle deflection play.

name: gFarSideBoards5On3XFromBoards
label: Far-Side Boards PP X from Boards (5 on 3)
help: X offset from the boards for the far-side player during a 5-on-3 power play.

name: gFarSideBoards5On3PosZ
label: Far-Side Boards PP Z Position (5 on 3)
help: Z position for the far-side boards player during a 5-on-3 power play.

name: gFarSideBoards5On4XFromBoards
label: Far-Side Boards PP X from Boards (5 on 4)
help: X offset from the boards for the far-side player during a 5-on-4 power play.

name: gFarSideBoards5On4PosZ
label: Far-Side Boards PP Z Position (5 on 4)
help: Z position for the far-side boards player during a 5-on-4 power play.

name: gAvgForAccumMin
label: Average for Accumulation Min
help: Averaging factor used to smooth accumulation toward the minimum pass power.

name: gAvgForAccumMax
label: Average for Accumulation Max
help: Averaging factor used to smooth accumulation toward the maximum pass power.

name: gAccumMinMethod1
label: Power Accumulation Min Method 1
help: Minimum accumulation value used by pass power method 1 calculation.

name: gAccumMaxMethod1
label: Power Accumulation Max Method 1
help: Maximum accumulation value used by pass power method 1 calculation.

name: gTimeToMaxForMaxRate
label: Time To Max Charge (Max Rate)
help: Frames needed to reach maximum pass power when charging at the maximum rate.

name: gTimeToMaxForMinRate
label: Time To Max Charge (Min Rate)
help: Frames needed to reach maximum pass power when charging at the minimum rate.

name: gMaxAccumRate
label: Max Power Accumulation Rate
help: Maximum rate at which pass power accumulates per tick.

name: gMinAccumRate
label: Min Power Accumulation Rate
help: Minimum rate at which pass power accumulates per tick.

name: gTimeForMinAccum
label: Time For Min Accumulation
help: Frames of input accumulation required to reach the minimum powered-pass charge level.

name: gTimeForMaxAccum
label: Time for Max Accumulation
help: Time (sec) required to charge a pass to its maximum accumulated power.

name: gAccumMinMethod2
label: Power Accumulation Min Method 2
help: Minimum accumulation value used by pass power method 2 calculation.

name: gAccumMaxMethod2
label: Power Accumulation Max Method 2
help: Maximum accumulation value used by pass power method 2 calculation.

name: gAccumTimeout
label: Power Accumulation Timeout
help: Ticks before an uncommitted powered-pass accumulation resets.

name: gUseMaxValueForTotal
label: Use Max Value For Total
help: When enabled, uses the maximum accumulated value instead of the sum for powered pass control.

name: gAlwaysAutoHit
label: Always Auto Hit
help: Forces auto-hit mode on regardless of player settings or difficulty level.

name: gNeverAutoHit
label: Never Auto Hit
help: Disables auto-hit completely, requiring all body checks to be manually triggered.

name: gHitTargetFinishCheckTime
label: Hit Target Finish Check Time
help: Ticks allowed to finish confirming a hit target before the action is abandoned.

name: gHitTargetFinishCheckTimeLooseMatch
label: Hit Target Finish Check Time (Loose Match)
help: Extended ticks for hit target confirmation when using loose matching criteria.

name: gAutoHitExtraFinishCheckTimeForPuckNotInSameDirection
label: Auto Hit Extra Finish Time (Puck Opposite Dir)
help: Extra ticks added to finish-check window when puck moves in the opposite direction.

name: gAutoHitEarlyHitFrames
label: Auto Hit Early Hit Frames
help: Number of frames before predicted contact where an early auto-hit can be triggered.

name: gAutoHitEarlyMaxFeetToPuck
label: Auto Hit Early Max Feet To Puck
help: Maximum distance from checker to puck for an early auto-hit to be allowed.

name: gAutoHitExtraFeetToEarlyHit
label: Auto Hit Extra Feet To Early Hit
help: Additional distance tolerance added when evaluating early auto-hit eligibility.

name: gAutoHitExtraGetPuckTicksToEarlyHit
label: Auto Hit Extra Get-Puck Ticks To Early Hit
help: Additional ticks allowed for puck retrieval before an early auto-hit is abandoned.

name: gAutoHitMinGetPuckToEarlyHit
label: Auto Hit Min Get-Puck To Early Hit
help: Minimum get-puck score required before an early auto-hit attempt is allowed.

name: gAutoHitRequiresRecheckEachFrame
label: Auto Hit Requires Recheck Each Frame
help: Forces the auto-hit eligibility conditions to be re-evaluated every frame.

name: gMinLeftStickForAutoCheck
label: Min Left Stick Magnitude For Auto Check
help: Minimum left analog stick deflection required to trigger auto-check behavior.

name: gMinRelSpeedForAutoCheck
label: Min Relative Speed For Auto Check
help: Minimum closing speed between checker and target for auto-check to activate.

name: gMinSpeedToCareAboutRelSpeedForAutoCheck
label: Min Speed To Apply Relative Speed Auto-Check
help: Minimum checker speed at which relative-speed gating is applied to auto-check.

name: gMaxInterceptTimeForAutoCheck
label: Max Intercept Time For Auto Check
help: Maximum predicted intercept time for the auto-check system to commit to a check.

name: gAutoHitLeftStickAngleToInterceptTolerance
label: Auto Hit Stick-To-Intercept Angle Tolerance
help: Maximum angle between left-stick direction and intercept path for auto-hit to engage.

name: gAutoHitLeftStickAngleToTargetTolerance
label: Auto Hit Stick-To-Target Angle Tolerance
help: Maximum angle between left-stick direction and target for auto-hit to engage.

name: gAutoHitPreventWhenPuckIsInSameDirTolerance
label: Auto Hit Prevent Same-Dir Puck Tolerance
help: Angle tolerance within which auto-hit is suppressed when puck moves same direction as player.

name: gAutoHitGetPuckBias
label: Auto Hit Get-Puck Bias
help: Bias value that tips auto-hit toward getting the puck over attempting the check.

name: gAutoHitGetPuckMax
label: Auto Hit Get-Puck Max
help: Maximum get-puck score before auto-hit commits to puck retrieval over checking.

name: gAutoHitTargetRadius
label: Auto Hit Target Radius
help: Radius around an opponent within which they qualify as an auto-hit target.

name: gAutoHitInterceptRadius
label: Auto Hit Intercept Radius
help: Radius around the predicted intercept point within which auto-hit locks onto a target.

name: gAutoHitAimingAtTargetDist
label: Auto Hit Aiming At Target Distance
help: Distance within which the auto-hit system considers the stick aimed at a target.

name: gAutoHitDefaultCancelActionRefractoryPeriod
label: Auto Hit Cancel Refractory Period
help: Cooldown ticks before auto-hit can trigger again after being cancelled by an action.

name: gAutoHitBoardplayActionRefractoryPeriod
label: Auto Hit Boardplay Refractory Period
help: Cooldown ticks before auto-hit can trigger again after a boardplay action.

name: gAutoHitReleaseLeftStickRefractoryPeriod
label: Auto Hit Left Stick Release Refractory Period
help: Cooldown ticks after left-stick release before auto-hit can trigger again.

name: gUseAutoCheckHysteresis
label: Use Auto Check Hysteresis
help: Applies hysteresis to auto-check activation to prevent rapid on/off toggling.

name: gCancelThrowHitOnRecheck
label: Cancel Throw Hit On Recheck
help: Cancels an in-progress throw hit if a re-evaluation finds no valid target.

name: gBlockPassingForLocked
label: Block Passing For Locked Player
help: Prevents passing inputs from being processed while a player is in a locked state.

name: gNumHumanPlayersExcludingGoaliesTestLock
label: Human Player Count Test Lock (No Goalies)
help: Debug lock overriding the number of human-controlled skaters (excluding goalies) for testing.

name: gPlayerSwitchDefensiveSideBuffer
label: Player Switch Defensive Side Buffer
help: Buffer distance on the defensive side used when evaluating player-switching candidates.

name: gAllowClosestToInterceptSwitching
label: Allow Closest-To-Intercept Switching
help: Allows the AI to auto-switch control to the player closest to intercepting the puck.

name: gSwitchMinDistFromCurrent
label: Switch Min Distance From Current Player
help: Minimum distance a candidate must be from the current player to be eligible for auto-switching.

name: gConsiderLikelyReceiverAsPCForSwitching
label: Consider Likely Receiver As PC For Switching
help: Treats the most likely pass receiver as the player-controlled skater when deciding who to switch to.

name: gBAP_AllowBadChanges
label: Be-A-Pro Allow Bad Line Changes
help: Permits line changes in Be-A-Pro mode even when the timing would be considered poor.

name: gMinStrengthForSauce
label: Min Strength for Sauce Pass
help: Minimum pass strength required before a sauce (saucer) pass can be executed.

name: gManualGoalieAnalogSkateDistance
label: Manual Goalie Analog Skate Distance
help: Distance (ft) a manual goalie moves per full analog stick deflection per tick.

name: gUserCreatePlayDelay
label: User Create-Play Input Delay
help: Delay in ticks before user create-play input is accepted after activation.

name: gChopsInCustom
label: Chops Enabled In Custom Mode
help: Enables chop/slap shot moves when playing in custom game mode.

name: gMaxOtpScoreDiffForGoaliePull
label: Max OTP Score Diff for Goalie Pull
help: Maximum score differential at which the AI will consider pulling the goalie in OTP.

name: gOtpPullGoalieTime
label: OTP Pull Goalie Time
help: Game-time threshold (in ticks) remaining at which the AI considers pulling the goalie in OTP.

name: gEnableGoalieSwapNISReplay
label: Enable Goalie Swap NIS (Replay)
help: Enables goalie-swap cinematic during replay penalty situations.

name: gEnableGoalieSwapNISNonReplay
label: Enable Goalie Swap NIS (Non-Replay)
help: Enables goalie-swap cinematic during live play (non-replay) penalty situations.

name: gEnableGoalieSwapNISTeamPenalty
label: Enable Goalie Swap NIS on Team Penalty
help: Allows goalie-swap cinematic to trigger specifically on team penalty situations.

name: gEnableGoalieSwapNISAnyPenalty
label: Enable Goalie Swap NIS on Any Penalty
help: Allows goalie-swap cinematic to trigger on any penalty situation.

name: gThruPassPowerScale
label: Through Pass Power Scale
help: Scaling factor applied to pass power for through (seam) passes.

name: gMaxSaucePassStrength
label: Max Sauce Pass Strength
help: Upper limit on the strength value applied to a sauce (lofted) pass.

name: gMaxPushPuckFrames
label: Max Push Puck Frames
help: Maximum number of frames the AI will push the puck forward before committing to another action.

name: gAutoReleaseAtMaxPower
label: Auto Release At Max Power
help: When enabled, AI automatically releases a shot when charge reaches maximum power.

name: gTimeForMaxPassPower
label: Time for Max Pass Power
help: Button hold duration (ticks) needed to reach maximum pass power.

name: gTimeForMinPassPower
label: Time for Min Pass Power
help: Minimum button hold duration (ticks) that produces the minimum pass power.

name: gPassPowerRatioForMinPassPower
label: Pass Power Ratio for Min Pass Power
help: Ratio determining the minimum deliverable pass power relative to the full power scale.

name: gMaxPoweredPassPower
label: Max Powered Pass Power
help: Upper cap on powered-pass strength level that can be charged.

name: gPassPowerOverlapTime
label: Pass Power Overlap Time
help: Duration of overlap window in ticks when blending old and new pass power inputs.

name: gUseAnalogPoweredPasses
label: Use Analog Powered Passes
help: Enables analog stick charge-up for powered pass strength rather than a fixed value.

name: gPassStrengthForDropPass
label: Pass Strength for Drop Pass
help: Fixed pass strength value assigned when a drop pass is executed.

name: gLeftStickDeflectionForDropPass
label: Left Stick Deflection for Drop Pass
help: Minimum left-stick deflection level required to trigger a drop pass.

name: gTicksAfterWhichLoosePuck
label: Ticks After Which Puck Is Loose
help: Number of ticks elapsed before an uncontrolled puck is classified as loose.

name: gTimeToPuckToDoOnetimer
label: Time to Puck for One-Timer
help: Maximum ticks to puck contact within which a one-timer can be attempted.

name: gCallForPassDelay
label: Call For Pass Delay
help: Number of frames delay between a call-for-pass gesture and the pass being triggered.

name: gCallForPassMinScore
label: Call For Pass Min Lane Score
help: Minimum pass-lane score required for AI to respond to a call-for-pass request.

name: gEnableCallForPassMinScore
label: Enable Min Pass Lane Score for Call for Pass
help: Gates whether a minimum lane score is required before an AI player calls for a pass.

name: gUCSlapWindupCallsForPass
label: UC Slap Windup Calls for Pass
help: Controls whether a user-controlled slap-shot windup triggers a call for pass.

name: gUCSlapWindupCallsForPassOnHold
label: UC Slap Windup Calls for Pass (On Hold)
help: Controls call-for-pass behavior when the user holds a slap-shot windup input.

name: gMinLaneChanceForWindupCallForPass
label: Min Lane Chance for Windup Call for Pass
help: Minimum lane score needed during a shot windup to trigger a call-for-pass.

name: gCallForPassDelayOnWindup
label: Call For Pass Delay On Windup
help: Additional delay ticks applied to a call-for-pass when the passer is in a windup.

name: gMinLaneChanceForGoaliePass
label: Min Lane Chance for Goalie Pass
help: Minimum passing lane quality score before the goalie will initiate a pass.

name: gBAPVeryBadCancelPassChance
label: Be-A-Pro Very Bad Cancel Pass Chance
help: Probability that a Be-A-Pro AI player cancels a pass with a very bad outcome.

name: gBAPBadCancelPassChance
label: Be-A-Pro Bad Cancel Pass Chance
help: Probability that a Be-A-Pro AI player cancels a pass badly (poor result).

name: gBAPPoorCancelPassChance
label: Be-A-Pro Poor Cancel Pass Chance
help: Probability that a Be-A-Pro AI player cancels a pass with a poor (mediocre) outcome.

name: gCallForPassBlockQueuedPassTicks
label: Call For Pass Block Queued Pass Ticks
help: Ticks a queued pass is blocked after a call-for-pass gesture is issued.

name: gMinPreFaceoffTicksForSlash
label: Min Pre-Faceoff Ticks for Slash
help: Minimum ticks before a faceoff at which the AI may perform a slash.

name: gLPDaLoosePuckCheckForPuckDistance
label: Loose Puck Detect Puck Distance Check
help: Distance threshold used when checking for a loose puck during loose-puck detection.

name: gPuckDistFromSkaterToNotPassBlock
label: Puck Distance From Skater: No Pass Block
help: General distance threshold from the skater below which pass-block collision is suppressed.

name: gPuckDistFromSkaterOnSideToNotPassBlock
label: Puck Distance On Side Of Skater: No Pass Block
help: When puck is this far to the side of the skater, pass-block collision is suppressed.

name: gPuckDistFromSkaterBehindToNotPassBlock
label: Puck Distance Behind Skater: No Pass Block
help: When puck is this far behind the skater, pass-block collision is suppressed.

name: gLPDaLoosePuckLikelyReceiver
label: Loose Puck Likely Receiver Check
help: Enables identification of the most likely puck receiver when deciding loose-puck actions.

name: gPlayerDistFromNetToFinishOneTimerAfterAcquire
label: Player Distance From Net To Finish One-Timer
help: Player must be within this distance from the net to complete a one-timer after puck acquisition.

name: gPuckDistFromNetToFinishOneTimerAfterAcquire
label: Puck Distance From Net To Finish One-Timer
help: Puck must be within this distance from the net to allow a one-timer completion after acquisition.

name: gDistFromPuckToFinishOneTimerAfterAcquire
label: Distance From Puck To Finish One-Timer
help: Maximum puck-to-stick distance still allowed when finishing a one-timer after acquiring the puck.

name: gMaxSecsToPuckForLoosePuckOneTimer
label: Max Seconds To Reach Puck For One-Timer
help: Maximum predicted time-to-puck for a loose-puck one-timer to be considered valid.

name: gMaxPuckHeightForOneTimer
label: Max Puck Height For One-Timer
help: Maximum puck height off the ice at which a one-timer attempt is allowed.

name: gMinDistToNetForTriggeredCpuOnetimer
label: Min Distance To Net For CPU One-Timer
help: Minimum distance from the net required before the CPU will trigger a one-timer attempt.

name: gMaxDistForLoosePuckOneTimer
label: Max Distance For Loose Puck One-Timer
help: Maximum puck-to-stick-tip distance for a loose-puck one-timer to be eligible.

name: gMinDistFromBoardsForLoosePuckOneTimer
label: Min Distance From Boards For One-Timer
help: Loose-puck one-timer is not attempted when the puck is closer than this to the boards.

name: gClearWinnerTime
label: Loose Puck Clear Winner Time
help: Time in seconds a player must maintain loose-puck advantage to be declared the clear winner.

name: gNumSecsToWaitAfterPuckLoss
label: Seconds To Wait After Puck Loss
help: Delay in seconds before the user-control system re-evaluates actions after losing the puck.

name: gAggressiveCheckButtonTap
label: Aggressive Check Button Tap Threshold
help: Tap duration threshold (in ticks) that distinguishes an aggressive check input from a normal one.

name: gOneTimerAlmostAlwaysTriggerCpu
label: One-Timer Almost Always Trigger CPU
help: Makes the CPU nearly always complete a one-timer when conditions are met, for testing.

name: gOneTimerTriggerCpuAfterPassSeconds
label: One-Timer CPU Trigger Delay After Pass
help: Seconds after a pass before the CPU is allowed to auto-trigger a one-timer.

name: gMaxSecondsToFinishOneTimerAfterAcquireFromPlayer
label: Max Seconds To Finish One-Timer (From Player)
help: Time window in seconds to complete a one-timer after receiving a pass from a skater.

name: gMaxSecondsToFinishOneTimerAfterAcquireFromGoalie
label: Max Seconds To Finish One-Timer (From Goalie)
help: Time window in seconds to complete a one-timer after receiving a pass from the goalie.

name: gAlwaysEnableGoofOffHitting
label: Always Enable Goof-Off Hitting
help: Forces goof-off hitting behavior to be always available regardless of game state.

name: gPossessSecsForNoNearNetHit
label: Possession Seconds For No Near-Net Hit
help: Player must have possessed the puck for at least this many seconds before near-net hits are suppressed.

name: gTicksSinceTouchForNoHitsNearNet
label: Ticks Since Touch For No Hits Near Net
help: Number of ticks since last puck touch after which near-net hit suppression kicks in.

name: gDistToAttackingNetForNoHits
label: Distance To Attacking Net: No Hits
help: Within this distance from the attacking net, user-controlled hits are suppressed.

name: gIgnoreRegularCheckRequest
label: Ignore Regular Check Request
help: Suppresses regular body-check requests from the input system, useful for debug overrides.

name: gMinTicksToAllowChop
label: Min Ticks To Allow Chop
help: Minimum number of ticks that must elapse before a chop action is permitted again.

name: gAllowFightsDuringGameplay
label: Allow Fights During Gameplay
help: Enables player-initiated fights to occur during active play.

name: gDistFromNetToAllowShotInsteadOfHit
label: Distance From Net: Shot Instead Of Hit
help: Within this distance from the net the game prefers a shot over a hit when input is ambiguous.

name: gAllowGoofOffSlashing
label: Allow Goof-Off Slashing
help: Allows casual/goof-off slashing animations and behavior outside of active penalty situations.

name: gAllowInGameSlashing
label: Allow In-Game Slashing
help: Enables slashing interactions between players during live gameplay.

name: gUseLeftStickForChop
label: Use Left Stick For Chop
help: Routes chop direction input through the left stick rather than the right stick.

name: gAlwaysPokeWithCustomControls
label: Always Poke With Custom Controls
help: Forces poke-check to always use custom control mapping instead of the default scheme.

name: gProhibitChecking
label: Prohibit Checking
help: Completely disables body checking; useful for no-hitting rule modes.

name: gRABufferTicks
label: Right Analog Buffer Ticks
help: Input buffer size in ticks for right-analog stick commands to prevent premature action cancellation.

name: gPokeHoldTicks
label: Poke Hold Duration
help: Duration in ticks for a held poke-check input when no puck possession.

name: gPokeHoldTicksPossessed
label: Poke Hold Duration (Possessed)
help: Duration in ticks for a held poke-check when the opponent has puck possession.

name: gPokeTapTicks
label: Poke Tap Duration
help: Duration in ticks that defines a short tap for the poke-check action.

name: gPokeFlickTicks
label: Poke Flick Duration
help: Duration in ticks of a poke-check flick input.

name: gHipCheckRefractoryTime
label: Hip Check Refractory Time
help: Cooldown ticks after a hip check during which another hip check cannot be initiated.

name: gMaxAngleForPoke
label: Max Angle For Poke Check
help: Maximum angle between the defender and puck carrier at which a poke check can be attempted.

name: gFeetToNetForAssistedChop
label: Feet To Net For Assisted Chop
help: Distance from the net in feet within which an assisted chop move can be triggered.

name: gDegreesToNetForAssistedChop
label: Angle To Net For Assisted Chop
help: Maximum angle between the player's facing direction and the net to allow an assisted chop.

name: gDoAssistedChopAngle
label: Use Angle Check For Assisted Chop
help: Enables the angle-to-net check as a condition before allowing an assisted chop.

name: gAllowCheckOnRightAnalogStateNone
label: Allow Check On Right Analog Neutral
help: Permits a check action when the right analog stick is in the neutral (no-input) state.

name: gAutoCheckCancelDelay
label: Auto-Check Cancel Delay
help: Number of ticks to wait before cancelling an auto-triggered check attempt.

name: gMaxAngleDiffForGoalieDump
label: Max Angle Difference For Goalie Dump
help: Maximum angular difference between facing and target direction to allow a goalie dump.

name: gRightStickMinMag
label: Right Stick Min Magnitude
help: Minimum right stick deflection required to register a goalie save direction input.

name: gDisallowShovesIfGoalieHasPuck
label: Disallow Shoves When Goalie Has Puck
help: Prevents the goalie from performing shoves while holding the puck.

name: gGoalieFightAcceptLoosePuckDist
label: Goalie Accept Loose Puck Distance
help: Maximum distance from a loose puck within which the goalie will attempt to collect it.

name: gUserControl_HandlePlayerFailedAssign
label: Handle Player Failed Assign (Paranoia)
help: Enables a fallback handler when a goalie player assignment fails (debug/safety).

name: gLastManBackTime
label: Last Man Back Time
help: Frame count for which the 'last man back' condition must persist before goalie response.

name: gSwitchToGoalieTime
label: Switch to Goalie Time
help: Frame duration for the transition when switching player control to the goalie.

name: gAllowLoosePuckPasses
label: Allow Loose Puck Passes
help: Allows the goalie to pass a loose puck that is not fully controlled.

name: gClearRightTriggerOnSwitch
label: Clear Right Trigger on Goalie Switch
help: Resets the right trigger input state when control is switched to the goalie.

name: gAllowDirectSwitch
label: Allow Direct Goalie Switch
help: Allows the user to directly switch control to the goalie without transition delay.

name: gLateralAccelForPushPuck
label: Lateral Acceleration for Puck Push
help: Lateral acceleration rate applied when the goalie pushes the puck to the side.

name: gAssistedDefenseEffort
label: Assisted Defense Effort Level
help: Controls how aggressively the assisted defense AI pursues the puck carrier.

name: gAssistedDefenseGapType
label: Assisted Defense Gap Type
help: Index selecting which gap-control strategy the assisted defense uses.

name: gAssistedDefenseCheckThreatRating
label: Assisted Defense Check Threat Rating
help: Threat-rating level at which assisted defense will trigger a check on the puck carrier.

name: gAssistedDefenseMaxDist
label: Assisted Defense Max Distance
help: Maximum distance from the puck at which assisted defense will activate for a skater.

name: gAssistedDefensePushRadius
label: Assisted Defense Push Radius
help: Radius within which the assisted defense will push a defender toward the puck carrier.

name: gEnableAssistedDefenseMode
label: Enable Assisted Defense Mode
help: Master toggle that enables the assisted defense mode for user-controlled players.

name: gAntiTimeWastingEnabled
label: Anti Time-Wasting Enabled
help: Master toggle for the anti-time-wasting system that discourages stalling behavior.

name: gAntiTimeWastingOffline
label: Anti Time-Wasting Enabled Offline
help: Enables the anti-time-wasting system specifically during offline (local) games.

name: gAntiTimeWastingOtp
label: Anti Time-Wasting Enabled OTP
help: Enables the anti-time-wasting system during Online Team Play (OTP) games.

name: gAntiTimeWastingMinTime
label: Anti Time-Wasting Min Time
help: Minimum elapsed frames of stalling before the anti-time-wasting system activates.

name: gAntiTimeWastingIgnoreScore
label: Anti Time-Wasting Ignore Score
help: When enabled, anti-time-wasting penalties are applied regardless of the current score.

name: gBoostOnHold
label: Boost On Hold
help: When enabled, the speed boost activates while the boost button is held down.

name: gMaxSpeedForProtectPuckWithViscon
label: Max Speed for Protect Puck with Vision Control
help: Maximum player speed at which puck-protection with active vision control is permitted.

name: gBoostRateForAutoPushPuck
label: Boost Rate for Auto Push Puck
help: Rate at which boost energy is consumed during the automatic puck-push acceleration.

name: gBoostStraightFramesForAutoPushPuck
label: Boost Straight Frames for Auto Push Puck
help: Number of frames a player must skate straight before auto puck-push boost engages.

name: gTurnRumbleLength
label: Turn Rumble Length
help: Duration in frames of controller rumble triggered by sharp skating turns.

name: gOffbalancenessForRumbleStart
label: Off-Balance Intensity for Rumble Start
help: Off-balance value at which controller rumble begins to activate.

name: gOffbalancenessForRumbleMax
label: Off-Balance Intensity for Rumble Max
help: Off-balance value at which controller rumble reaches its maximum intensity.

name: gBalanceRumbleMin
label: Balance Rumble Min
help: Minimum off-balance intensity required before controller rumble is triggered.

name: gTurnRumblePct
label: Turn Rumble %
help: Percentage of maximum rumble intensity applied during a skating turn event.

name: gTurnRumbleOppPct
label: Turn Rumble Opponent %
help: Percentage of turn rumble intensity applied when an opponent causes the turn.

name: gSkateEffortEdgeDeadZone
label: Skate Effort Edge Dead Zone
help: Analog stick dead-zone threshold at the edge of input range for skating effort.

name: gMaintainUserControlledVisionControlOfCarrierIfIdle
label: Maintain Vision Control of Carrier When Idle
help: Keeps user-controlled vision focus on the puck carrier even while the user is idle.

name: gMainUserControlledVisionControlOfCarrierIfIdle
label: Vision Control of Carrier When Idle (Main)
help: Determines if the main user retains vision-control lock on the puck carrier when idle.

name: gAngleToleranceToDoBoost
label: Angle Tolerance to Boost (OTP)
help: Maximum angle deviation allowed before auto-boost is suppressed for OTP skating.

name: gPadMagnitudeToEstablishVisConTransState
label: Pad Magnitude to Establish Vision Control Transition
help: Analog stick magnitude required to trigger a vision-control transition state.

name: gMaxFramesToWaitForInactiveVisCon
label: Max Frames to Wait for Inactive Vision Control
help: Maximum frames the system waits for an inactive vision-control assignment before releasing it.

name: gMaintainVisionControlOnPossessionTransitions
label: Maintain Vision Control on Possession Change
help: Retains current vision-control target when puck possession changes between players.

name: gMagnumAnalysisSkatingBias

name: gMaxMinShotChanceFacingAwayFromNet
label: Max Min Chance Facing Away From Net
help: Maximum value of the minimum shot-chance score when the shooter faces away from the net.

name: gDistToUseHighShotFacingAwayFromNetChance
label: High Shot Distance Facing Away From Net
help: Distance at which a high shot is preferred when the player faces away from the net.

name: gDistForNoPenFacingAwayFromNetChance
label: No Penalty Distance Facing Away From Net
help: Distance at which no penalty is applied when the shooter is facing away from the net.

name: gShotControlTime
label: Shot Control Time
help: Duration of puck control after which the shot-control penalty begins to accumulate.

name: gShotControlPenalty
label: Shot Control Penalty
help: Penalty subtracted from shot-quality score based on how long the player has controlled the puck.

name: gIdealShotOffsetAngle
label: Ideal Shot Offset Angle
help: Angular offset from straight-on that defines the ideal shooting angle toward the net.

name: gTrafficWeight
label: Traffic Weight
help: Weight applied to the traffic-in-front-of-net factor when computing shooting-chance quality.

name: gBackhanderShotQuality
label: Backhand Shot Quality
help: Base shot-quality score assigned to a standard backhand attempt in the shot-lane analysis.

name: gFarBackhanderShotQuality
label: Far Backhand Shot Quality
help: Shot-quality score assigned to a backhand attempt from long range.

name: gDistForFarBackhand
label: Far Backhand Distance
help: Distance threshold beyond which a backhand is classified as a far backhand shot.

name: gUseSuggestedShotTypeToDeterminePower
label: Use Suggested Shot Type for Power
help: When enabled, the AI derives shot power from the suggested shot type rather than a separate calculation.

name: gMinOffZoneTimeShooting
label: Min Off-Zone Time Shooting
help: Minimum off-zone ticks before any shooting-chance penalty begins to accumulate.

name: gMaxOffZoneTimeShooting
label: Max Off-Zone Time Shooting
help: Maximum ticks a player can be off-zone and still receive a full shooting-chance score.

name: gMinOffZoneTimeShootingWeight
label: Min Off-Zone Shooting Weight
help: Weight applied to the off-zone time penalty at its minimum boundary for shot analysis.

name: gMaxOffZoneTimeShootingWeight
label: Max Off-Zone Shooting Weight
help: Weight applied to the off-zone time penalty at its maximum boundary for shot analysis.

name: gIgnoreImmediateChanceDist
label: Ignore Immediate Chance Distance
help: Distance beyond which an immediate scoring chance is ignored in shot-lane analysis.

name: gFullImmediateChanceDist
label: Full Immediate Chance Distance
help: Distance from the net within which a shot is considered a full immediate scoring chance.

name: gSkatingLossNotDefTargetLimit
label: Skating Loss Non-Def Target Limit
help: Maximum number of non-defensive opponents counted when computing skating puck-loss risk.

name: gGoalieSkatingLossChancePerFrame
label: Goalie Skating Loss Chance per Frame
help: Per-frame probability that a skating goalie causes the carrier to lose puck control.

name: gSkatingLossChanceEndFrameHigh
label: High Thresh Loss Chance End Frame
help: Last frame of the high-threshold loss-chance window during skating threat evaluation.

name: gSkatingLossChanceStartFrameHigh
label: High Thresh Loss Chance Start Frame
help: First frame of the high-threshold loss-chance window during skating threat evaluation.

name: gSkatingLossHowReachableThresholdHigh
label: Loss How-Reachable High Threshold
help: Reachability score above which the high-tier loss-chance parameters are applied.

name: gSkatingLossChancePerFrameHigh
label: High Thresh Loss Chance per Frame
help: Per-frame puck-loss probability used when opponent reachability exceeds the high threshold.

name: gSkatingLossChancePerFrameProtectPuckHigh
label: Protect Puck High Thresh Loss Chance/Frame
help: Per-frame loss-chance at the high threshold when the carrier is in puck-protection stance.

name: gSkatingStepUpForMaxTimes100High
label: High Thresh Step-Up For Max x100
help: Scaled-by-100 step-up increment toward the maximum for the high reachability threshold.

name: gSkatingStepUpForMinTimes100High
label: High Thresh Step-Up For Min x100
help: Scaled-by-100 step-up increment toward the minimum for the high reachability threshold.

name: gSkatingStepUpMaxHigh
label: High Thresh Step-Up Maximum
help: Maximum step-up value for the high-threshold path in skating loss-chance ramp calculation.

name: gSkatingStepUpMinHigh
label: High Thresh Step-Up Minimum
help: Minimum step-up value for the high-threshold path in skating loss-chance ramp calculation.

name: gSkatingLossChanceEndFrameLow
label: Low Thresh Loss Chance End Frame
help: Last frame of the low-threshold loss-chance window during skating threat evaluation.

name: gSkatingLossChanceStartFrameLow
label: Low Thresh Loss Chance Start Frame
help: First frame of the low-threshold loss-chance window during skating threat evaluation.

name: gSkatingLossHowReachableThresholdLow
label: Loss How-Reachable Low Threshold
help: Reachability score below which the low-tier loss-chance parameters are applied.

name: gSkatingLossChancePerFrameLow
label: Low Thresh Loss Chance per Frame
help: Per-frame puck-loss probability used when opponent reachability is below the high threshold.

name: gSkatingLossChancePerFrameProtectPuckLow
label: Protect Puck Low Thresh Loss Chance/Frame
help: Per-frame loss-chance at the low threshold when the carrier is in puck-protection stance.

name: gSkatingStepUpForMaxTimes100Low
label: Low Thresh Step-Up For Max x100
help: Scaled-by-100 step-up increment toward the maximum for the low reachability threshold.

name: gSkatingStepUpForMinTimes100Low
label: Low Thresh Step-Up For Min x100
help: Scaled-by-100 step-up increment toward the minimum for the low reachability threshold.

name: gSkatingStepUpMaxLow
label: Low Thresh Step-Up Maximum
help: Maximum step-up value for the low-threshold path in skating loss-chance ramp calculation.

name: gSkatingStepUpMinLow
label: Low Thresh Step-Up Minimum
help: Minimum step-up value for the low-threshold path in skating loss-chance ramp calculation.

name: gHitLossChancePerFrame
label: Hit Puck Loss Chance per Frame
help: Per-frame probability of losing the puck due to a body-check contact during skating analysis.

name: gNearBoardsSafetyBuffer
label: Near Boards Safety Buffer
help: Safety margin from the boards used in skating path planning to reduce board collisions.

name: gOpponentPhysicalContactDistance
label: Opponent Physical Contact Distance
help: Distance within which an opponent is considered close enough to make physical contact.

name: gNearBoardsCollisionAvoidBuffer
label: Near Boards Collision Avoid Buffer
help: Buffer distance from boards within which AI actively steers to avoid a board collision.

name: gBoardCollisionLeadTime
label: Board Collision Lead Time
help: Ticks of lookahead used to predict board collisions when computing skating threat loss.

name: gSkateIntoBoardsCollisionRetentionMultiplier
label: Board Collision Puck Retention Multiplier
help: Multiplier applied per iteration to puck retention probability when skating into the boards.

name: gSkateIntoBoardsRetentionMultiplier
label: Board Skate Puck Retention Multiplier
help: One-time puck retention multiplier applied when a skater hits the boards.

name: gTeammateAvoidDistance
label: Teammate Avoid Distance
help: Distance within which AI skaters try to avoid colliding with teammates during movement.

name: gSkateIntoNetRetentionMultiplier
label: Net Collision Puck Retention Multiplier
help: Iterative puck retention multiplier applied each tick when a skater collides with the net.

name: gSkatingOnlyAvoidHuman
label: Skating Avoid Human Players Only
help: Restricts AI skating-avoidance logic to only apply to human-controlled opponents.

name: gSkatingOpponentCanReachLead
label: Opponent Can-Reach Lead Time
help: Lead-time buffer added when projecting whether an opponent can reach the puck carrier.

name: gSkatingLossUseStickPos
label: Skating Loss Use Stick Position
help: When enabled, stick position is factored into puck-loss probability during skating analysis.

name: gWorstAllowedSkatingRetention
label: Worst Allowed Skating Puck Retention
help: Minimum acceptable puck retention score below which a skating route is discarded by AI.

name: gMaxDiminishedSkatingFrameToConsider
label: Max Diminished Skating Lookahead Frames
help: Maximum frames ahead considered when diminishing skating-threat loss probabilities over time.

name: gMaxLookAheadForOffsideFrames
label: Max Lookahead for Offside Frames
help: Maximum frames ahead the AI projects player positions when checking for potential offsides.

name: gOffsideBluelineBuffer
label: Offside Blueline Buffer
help: Clearance buffer past the blueline applied when evaluating offside risk during skating.

name: gSkateForSpaceHitNetFactor
label: Skate for Space Hit-Net Factor
help: Bonus factor applied when skating for space leads directly to a net opportunity.

name: gSkateForSpaceBaseChance
label: Skate for Space Base Chance
help: Base probability the AI will choose to skate to open ice to create space.

name: gSkateForSpaceBaseNotFacingDirMod
label: Skate for Space Not-Facing Modifier
help: Score modifier when the AI skater is not already facing the target direction.

name: gSkateChancePenalty
label: Skate Chance Penalty
help: Penalty subtracted from AI skating-for-space opportunity scores.

name: gApplyCoverageSTRetentionToSkating
label: Apply Coverage Retention To Skating
help: Mode flag for applying coverage short-term retention influence to skating decisions.

name: gClipToRinkTolerance
label: Clip To Rink Tolerance
help: Distance tolerance used when clipping AI skating positions back inside the rink bounds.

name: gBlueLineDiminishSkateDistance
label: Blue Line Diminish Skate Distance
help: Distance from blue line at which AI skating space score starts to diminish for offside.

name: gBlueLineOffsideDiminishSkateDistance
label: Blue Line Offside Diminish Skate Distance
help: Distance at which AI penalises skating into offside position near the blue line.

name: gInsideBlueLineProximityPenalty
label: Inside Blue Line Proximity Penalty
help: Score penalty applied when an AI skater is too close to the blue line inside the zone.

name: gWeAreOffsideBlueLineProximityPenalty
label: Offside Blue Line Proximity Penalty
help: Score penalty applied to AI positioning options too close to the blue line while offside.

name: gTeammateBumpLossChancePerFrame
label: Teammate Bump Loss Chance Per Frame
help: Per-frame probability that an AI skater loses a space-skating position due to teammate bumping.

name: gRequiredSkateShortTermActionFrames
label: Skate Short-Term Action Required Frames
help: Frames required for a short-term skating action to be considered valid by AI.

name: gUseShotLaneInSkateChances
label: Use Shot Lane in Skate Chances
help: Enables shot lane quality as a factor when AI evaluates skate-for-chance positions.

name: gUseShotQualityInSkateChances
label: Use Shot Quality in Skate Chances
help: Enables shot quality scoring as a factor when AI evaluates skate-for-chance positions.

name: gUseSuggestedShotInSkateChances
label: Use Suggested Shot in Skate Chances
help: Enables the suggested best shot as a factor in AI skate-for-chance evaluation.

name: gGoalieSkateEffectRadius
label: Goalie Skate Effect Radius
help: Radius around the goalie within which skating-for-space logic is evaluated.

name: gTeammateSkateSpaceInflation
label: Teammate Skate Space Inflation
help: Buffer distance added around a teammate when evaluating available skating space.

name: gGoalieWhifWhenOutOfNetMultiplier
label: Goalie Whiff Out-of-Net Multiplier
help: Scales the chance the goalie whiffs on a save attempt when out of the net.

name: gAvoidancePredictionFrames
label: Avoidance Prediction Frames
help: Frames ahead AI predicts teammate proximity to trigger avoidance/spacing behaviour.

name: gTeammateTooCloseSetUpTime
label: Teammate Too Close Setup Time
help: Frames a teammate must be too close before the AI aborts its current setup position.

name: gTeammateTooCloseSetUpPenalty
label: Teammate Too Close Setup Penalty
help: Score penalty applied when an AI skater's target setup position is too close to a teammate.

name: gTeammateGoalieTooCloseSetUpPenalty
label: Own Goalie Too Close Setup Penalty
help: Score penalty applied when an AI skater's setup position is too close to the own goalie.

name: gSkateSimDrawFrequency
label: Skate Sim Draw Frequency
help: How often (in frames) the skating simulation draws its debug visualization.

name: gUseOldAntiTwitchAnalysisMethod
label: Use Old Anti-Twitch Analysis Method
help: Enables the legacy anti-twitch skating-space analysis algorithm.

name: gUseNewAntiTwitchAnalysisMethod
label: Use New Anti-Twitch Analysis Method
help: Enables the updated anti-twitch skating-space analysis algorithm.

name: gSkateOptionScale
label: Skate Option Scale
help: Global scale applied to all skate-for-space option scores.

name: gFinalAnalysisSkatePosFutureFrame
label: Analysis Skate Position Future Frames
help: How many frames ahead the AI skate-for-space analysis predicts skater positions.

name: gAntiTwitchMaxScale
label: Anti-Twitch Max Scale
help: Maximum damping scale applied by anti-twitch logic to suppress rapid direction changes.

name: gAntiTwitchMaxScaleDuringTransitions
label: Anti-Twitch Max Scale During Transitions
help: Anti-twitch damping ceiling applied specifically during skate transition animations.

name: gAntiTwitchAngleForMax
label: Anti-Twitch Angle For Max Scale
help: Input angle at which anti-twitch damping reaches its maximum scale value.

name: gAnalysisHoldPuckRampDownStart
label: Hold Puck Ramp-Down Start
help: Frame at which the AI begins ramping down its hold-puck evaluation score.

name: gAnalysisHoldPuckRampDownTime
label: Hold Puck Ramp-Down Time
help: Duration in frames over which the AI hold-puck score ramps down to zero.

name: gCosAngleOppRelVelForBonus
label: Opponent Relative Velocity Angle (Bonus Threshold)
help: Cosine angle threshold of opponent relative velocity at which a collision bonus begins.

name: gCosAngleOppRelVelForMaxBonus
label: Opponent Relative Velocity Angle (Max Bonus)
help: Cosine angle of opponent relative velocity required to receive the maximum collision bonus.

name: gCosAngleOppRelVelMaxBonus
label: Opponent Relative Velocity Max Bonus Value
help: Maximum bonus value awarded when opponent relative velocity angle meets the max threshold.

name: gCosAngleOppRelVelMaxBonusPuck
label: Opponent Relative Velocity Max Bonus (Puck)
help: Maximum bonus for puck-carrier when opponent relative velocity angle meets the threshold.

name: gMaxObtainPuckYFeet
label: Max Puck Obtain Height (ft)
help: Maximum puck height in feet at which a skater is eligible to obtain the puck.

name: gMaxObtainPuckYFeetGoalie
label: Max Puck Obtain Height — Goalie (ft)
help: Maximum puck height in feet at which a goalie is eligible to obtain the puck.

name: gPuckPredictMax_InPossession
label: Puck Predict Buffer Length (In Possession)
help: Number of frames ahead to predict puck position when a player is in possession of the puck.

name: gMinimalMovementRange
label: Minimal Movement Range
help: Minimum movement range considered significant when predicting who will reach the puck first.

name: gHeightToIndexAsMaxPickupHeightInFeet
label: Max Puck Pickup Height Index (ft)
help: Height in feet above ice used as the index ceiling for 'who will get puck' pickup height analysis.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ClosestOnTeamStablizer_On
label: Closest-On-Team Stabilizer Enabled
help: Enables the closest-on-team stabilizer to smooth out rapid changes in who-will-get-puck prediction.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ClosestOnTeamStablizer_P0
label: Closest-On-Team Stabilizer — Parameter 0
help: First tuning parameter for the closest-on-team stabilizer hysteresis logic.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ClosestOnTeamStablizer_P1
label: Closest-On-Team Stabilizer — Parameter 1
help: Second tuning parameter for the closest-on-team stabilizer hysteresis logic.

name: gNumFramePenaltyToPasser
label: Frame Penalty to Passer
help: Frame cost added to passer's puck-arrival estimate after releasing a pass, to favor switching to receiver.

name: gNumFramePenaltyToPasserSaucer
label: Frame Penalty to Passer — Saucer Pass
help: Frame penalty applied to the passer after a saucer pass, to encourage switching control to receiver.

name: gNumFramePenaltyToPasserDropPass
label: Frame Penalty to Passer — Drop Pass
help: Frame penalty applied to the passer after a drop pass, to encourage switching control to receiver.

name: gNumFramePenaltyToPasserBoardPinned
label: Frame Penalty to Passer — Board Pinned
help: Frame penalty applied to the passer when they are pinned to the boards, aiding receiver switch.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_OffsidePenaltyBase
label: Offside Penalty Base Cost
help: Base frame cost added to offside players in the who-will-get-puck arrival estimate.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_OffsidePenaltyVar
label: Offside Penalty Variable Cost
help: Variable component of the offside frame penalty added to the who-will-get-puck arrival estimate.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ClosestOnPassingTeam
label: Switch to Closest on Passing Team
help: Enables switching puck possession prediction to the closest teammate after a pass is made.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ClosestOnPassingTeam_Paranoia
label: Closest on Passing Team — Paranoia Mode
help: Enables paranoia mode for closest-on-passing-team logic to reduce prediction errors on passes.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ApplyFramePenalty
label: Apply Frame Penalty to Passer
help: Enables the frame penalty system that biases puck-possession prediction toward the pass receiver.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_ApplyFramePenalty_Paranoia
label: Apply Frame Penalty — Paranoia Mode
help: Enables paranoia mode for frame penalty, applying it more aggressively to avoid incorrect passer selection.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_InvalidPlayer_Paranoia
label: Invalid Player Cost — Paranoia Mode
help: Heightened cost for ineligible players in paranoia mode of the who-will-get-puck calculation.

name: gWhoWillGetPuck_InvalidPlayer
label: Invalid Player Cost
help: Cost added to ineligible player arrival estimates in the who-will-get-puck calculation.

name: gDisableCrowdCulling
label: Disable Crowd Culling
help: Disables frustum/occlusion culling of crowd geometry; may impact performance.

name: gEnablePostFX
label: Enable Post FX
help: Toggles all post-processing effects (bloom, color grading, etc.) on the rendered frame.

name: gEnablePostFXDebugInfo
label: Post FX Debug Info
help: Overlays post-processing debug information on screen for shader development.

name: gEnableRenderCamera
label: Enable Render Camera
help: Enables the render camera system used to drive scene rendering from a camera transform.

name: gCameraControllerID
label: Camera Controller ID
help: Index identifying the active camera controller preset.

name: gCameraInvertY
label: Camera Invert Y Axis
help: Inverts the Y-axis of camera look/aim input.

name: gOverrideCameraSettings
label: Override Camera Settings
help: Enables debug overrides for render camera position and Euler angles.

name: gOverrideCameraPos
label: Override Camera Position
help: Debug index selecting which position axis to override on the render camera.

name: gOverrideCameraEuler
label: Override Camera Euler
help: Debug index selecting which Euler-angle component to override on the render camera.

name: gLODShader
label: LOD Shader Level
help: Selects the level-of-detail shader tier applied to materials based on object distance.

name: gEnableLynxBinaryFileLoad
label: Lynx Binary File Load
help: Enables loading pre-compiled Lynx shader binaries from disk instead of compiling at runtime.
